refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.PCRLock is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.PCRLock
# The category of measurements a .pcrlock file can be generated for or removed, as used by the Lock() method. type LockCategory( # Firmware code measurements (PCRs 0, 2, 4). firmwareCode, # Firmware configuration measurements (PCRs 1, 3, 5). firmwareConfig, # SecureBoot policy, i.e. the SecureBoot, PK, KEK, db and dbx EFI variables (PCR 7). secureBootPolicy, # SecureBoot authority measurements, i.e. the certificates used to validate the boot components (PCR 7). secureBootAuthority )
# A single variant of a .pcrlock component, i.e. one alternative the component may take, backed by a specific .pcrlock file. type ComponentVariant( # The identifier of this component variant. id: string, # The path of the .pcrlock file that defines this variant. path: string )
# [Requires 'more' flag] method ReadEventLog() -> ( record: object )
# Lists the defined .pcrlock components, streamed one component per reply. Must be called with the 'more' flag. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListComponents() -> ( # The identifier of the component. id: string, # The variants defined for this component, each backed by a .pcrlock file. variants: []ComponentVariant )
method MakePolicy( force: ?bool ) -> ()
method RemovePolicy() -> ()
# Generates or removes the .pcrlock file(s) for the selected category of measurements. Generates (locks) them by default, or removes (unlocks) them if 'lock' is false. method Lock( # The category of measurements to generate or remove a .pcrlock file for. category: LockCategory, # If true (the default), generate the .pcrlock file(s) for the selected category; if false, remove them again. lock: ?bool ) -> ()
error NoChange()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.PCRLock shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.PCRLock.ReadEventLog '{}' invokes its ReadEventLog method.
